notes.title: Another game from me
notes.content:
Hi all!

A little story about myself. Because of this COVID-19 situation I lost my job. So I made another game (Stozle) in my spare time to cover my expenses while I make Cowpocalypse Episode 2. It's a smaller game, not related to CP but if you like [b]exciting stories[/b] and[b] sudoku puzzles[/b] check it out!

[h1] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291090/Stozle__Solve_the_Mystery/]Stozle[/url] is available also here on Steam (from May 16). [/h1]

[h2]Don't forget: [b] 30% off on the first week! [/b] Make sure you don't miss it![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291090/Stozle__Solve_the_Mystery/

Cheers,
Balazs

notes.title: Bad news: Indiegogo won't happen
notes.content:
[h1]It's a really depressing feeling that after a huge ammount of preparation it turns out that I can't start a campaign from my country, Hungary. [/h1]

It shocked me, because the last time I checked I was on the eligable list (about 1 year ago). I don't know if Indiegogo updated their policy since then, or I was reading an outdated info before. In any case, I can't really do anything about it. I'm sorry that I made you guys excited and now I let you down. Believe me, it's a horrible news for me too. 

I believe that honesty is the best way to go. So here it is: without support I can't make Episode 2, so it surely won't happen in the near future. I hope that in the distant future I could start working on it, because I really enjoyed the development, but it's out of my sight for now.
[b]
Thanks for all the positive feedback I got for the game so far! I whish the best for everyone and that your dreams come true![/b]

notes.title: Episode 2 Update (2) - Indiegogo
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[h1][b]The crowdfunding campaign is going to be with Indiegogo![/b][/h1] The start date is [h1][b]September 7 [/b][/h1]

[b]Long story short:[/b] 
I have already wrote the story of the second episode (it will be the last, final episode), but [b]I can't finish it without you![/b] I am making this game alone and the development is really time/energy/money consuming. So for the second episode to be able to exist, I need your help! [b]With a sucessful Indiegogo campaign you can make my dream come true![/b] 

[h1]By supporting you also could get the game (with an epic-weird-humorous story) that you've been waiting for in your whole life![/h1]
[list]
[*] If you are interested, tell to your friends about the game and about the upcoming campaign!
[/list]
[list]
